grain: one nested diagnostic report, not independent flattened rows

trust_limit: Internal consistency and source-pin agreement of a user-shared report only. Raw user Download, inventory, game and Windows runtime were NOT independently inspected here. Report claims are not a signature or authorization.
new_test_scope: Synthetic in-memory manifests, disposable private SQLite, coordinate checks, exact size arithmetic, planner decisions, report anti-promotion; NOT installer, actual payload, power loss or Windows tests.

gates.evidence: Report accounting, expected pins and preserved unknown states reconcile; raw user inputs not independently revalidated here.
Diagnostic matching-or-unclassified projection is not proven vendor policy or install closure.
Inventory coordinates and sizes are not content proof. Current archive read budget is zero.
Existing single-pair owned sample is not a full updater. No general installer crash/disk-full/rollback result established by this audit.
User report is useful execution evidence, not independent native Windows regression coverage.
